The '''Immediac Model 10 spacesuit''' was an [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]] manufactured by [[LifeLine Technologies]]. The spacesuit was used for carrying out extravehicular repairs in the vacuum of [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The standard, back-mounted tank could provide [[Life support/Legends|life support]] for up to eight [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], although larger, additional tanks could be added to extend this [[Time/Legends|time]] to four [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. The spacesuit opened at the back which allowed the wearer to put the Model 10 on in under two [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]], with the detachable helmet and textured gloves fitting via sealed locking rings. A control panel on the front of the suit adjusted the life support system. [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] kept at least three Immediac Model 10's aboard his [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="MFOWM" />
